correctness.rationale: The explicitly defined four-site Markov generator has exact characteristic polynomial zQ(z); independently computed symbolic expansion agrees with the derived cubic. Its cubic discriminant is exactly P_k(4sinh^2(f/2)); for k>0 all coefficients of positive powers have strict negative signs from three quadratic discriminant witnesses, so P_k strictly decreases from nonnegative at f=0 to -infinity. This proves existence/uniqueness for k!=1 and the degenerate zero-bias case for k=1, as well as the exact real/complex eigenvalue trichotomy. The k downarrow0 and k to infinity limits follow from bracketed roots of rescaled polynomials, and the derived constants are verified by symbolic identities. An actual bundled checker constructs the original generator and passes exact symbolic and 58 numerical diagnostics; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete finite four-state phase classification: four sites are the smallest cyclic model with a nontrivial cubic transient spectrum, and the defect is a physically interpretable single bottleneck. The exact one-crossing theorem answers whether arbitrary finite kinetic disorder can suppress oscillatory relaxation at strong bias, while qualitatively different k-downarrow-zero and k-to-infinity limits identify singular bottleneck and fast-edge geometry. It is neither a parameter substitution nor an isolated arbitrary numeric eigenvalue calculation. Scope stays four sites only, with no claims of experimental robustness or quantum-coherent generality.
